lines.intro: A fizzy penguin belly-slides out of the snow, spinning wild circles!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the penguin?

soothe.great: Fae hums a soft snow song. The penguin's spins slow to a gentle wobble!
soothe.good: Fae hums quietly. The penguin slides a calm little curve.
soothe.miss: The penguin whooshes right past Fae's humming.

play.great: Maddie slides on her belly right beside the penguin! Whee!
play.good: Maddie hops through the snow. The penguin peeps along.
play.miss: Maddie chases snowflakes. The penguin slides on without her.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber down the slope. The penguin chases it like a sled!
cast.good: Sue's bobber sails on the breeze. The penguin's flippers flap happily.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber plops into a drift. The penguin belly-flops after it.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three snowballs. The penguin balances one on its beak!
juggle.good: Jordan lobs a snowball. The penguin catches it in a flipper hug.
juggle.miss: Jordan's snowball rolls past. The penguin wheezes, dizzy from spinning.

lines.snack: Fae shares a warm snack. The penguin gulps it, flippers out!
lines.burst: The penguin floofs up and whips a blizzard of snowballs at Fae!

burstResult.great: Fae sleds between the snowballs on her boots!
burstResult.good: Fae shields her face from most of the flurry!
burstResult.miss: POOF! Fae is a snowman now.

lines.soothed: The penguin flops onto its belly, cozy and calm. The fizz melts into snow!
lines.rest: Fae is all snowdrifted out. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae trudges back up the slope. The penguin slides circles in the snow.
